composed: check_hand over each question, entry_unbacked over each option

questions.question: [M1] The archive's roster gains families. The roster as the builder reads it from PLACE-papers main holds 75 entries. The draft appends seven families at their paths on main, in the ruling's order, so no slot changes: THE_EPSTEIN_CONTROL_OBJECT_v0_1, CERTIFIED_EVALUATION_IN_THE_STRIP_v0_1, THE_EULER_SPECIFICATION, W_SIGN2_DH_CONTRAST, MECHANISM_EXCLUSION, THE_EXCLUSION_ARCHITECTURE and DOMAIN_OSTROWSKI_UNIVERSALITY_v0_1 (its copy under archive/ not taken). The roster would go from 75 entries to 82. The agenda with every path is banked in relay data/b753_agenda.txt. Is [M1] passed or struck?

options.label: Passed
options.description: The row of data/b753_rules.txt, the list of the seven paths beside the base roster and the reader's change are written and committed, one git write per message. The base roster stays unedited. This act's mirror carries 82 files and MANIFEST.md.

options.label: Struck
options.description: Nothing is written. The roster stays at 75.

questions.question: [D1] The harness under the record. As read: this session's rows read version 2.1.322 and b752's session's rows read 2.1.321; the settings' model word is "fable", an alias; the update channel as the settings hold it is "latest". Three forms are drafted in relay data/b753_agenda.txt: (a) background updating switched off for the seat by the settings' env key, the program updated on the author's word between acts; (b) updating left as it is; (c) the update channel set to stable. In every form the version and the model are read at step zero and a change of version is an event. Which form passes, or is [D1] struck?

options.label: Passed as (a)
options.description: Background updating switched off by the settings' env key, its name read from the harness's documentation at the pass, before the write. The one settings key is written by the seat, the file read back and printed, and the form entered as a row of data/b753_rules.txt. It takes effect at the harness's next start.

options.label: Passed as (b)
options.description: Updating left as it is. The row of data/b753_rules.txt alone is written; no setting changes.

options.label: Passed as (c)
options.description: The update channel set to stable. The one settings key is written by the seat, the file read back and printed, and the form entered as a row of data/b753_rules.txt. It takes effect at the harness's next start.

options.label: Struck
options.description: Nothing is written. Step zero reads the version as (7)(viii) already orders.
